title: Character on a standard basis vector
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\gamma\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb F_2$, and let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The sign character associated with $\gamma$, evaluated at the $i$th standard basis vector, is $(-1)^{\gamma_i}$.
